A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''ant-like creatures''' lived on the lush [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Endor (planet)/Legends|same name]]. Those [[Bug (creature)|bugs]] had a segmented body to which eight [[Limb/Legends|legs]] were attached. Their heads featured two small [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and a pair of feelers. A social, if [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], species, those critters lived together in large groups and nested in holes in the ground. They were [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] creatures, feeding on both meat and wild [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruits]]. Despite their small size, these ants could not only lift, but also carry loads up to many times their own weight. Sometimes, a group of Endorian ants would attack an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]], a one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall [[Bear/Legends|bear]]-like [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], and then carry them to their holes before eating them.<ref name="WDW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Endorian ants appeared in ''[[Wicket and the Dandelion Warriors: An Ewok Adventure]]'',<ref name="WDW" /> the children's book adaptation of "[[To Save Deej]]," the fourth episode of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] TV series.<ref name="E:TSD">{{Ewoks|To Save Deej}}</ref> In real-life, [[Wikipedia:Ant|ants]] have six segmented legs, like all other [[Wikipedia:Insect|insects]].<ref name="Insects">{{WebCite|url=http://www.entomology.umn.edu/cues/4015/morpology|text=Insect Morphology|work=[http://www.entomology.umn.edu University of Minnesota: Department of Entomology]|archivedate=20050325081001}}</ref> The Endorian "ants," however, have eight legs,<ref name="WDW" /> like real-life [[Wikipedia:Arachnid|arachnids]].<ref name="Insects" />
